issues.text: The review (review-design.ru.md section 3 and 4) proposes p.fine for how_plan_note and the stage-1 note, and puts the plan note under the block. REQ-113 criterion 6 asks plain body text (no class fine or meta, 16 px, the colour of body). The description follows the requirement; the plan note is the first element of the steps section, above ol.steps (after the block, before div.how-stages).

Two further departures from the review, both [P]: the marks .stat are not uppercase (the review took the .lbl look; innerText would read capitals while the test compares the key's value), and the names beside the stage-1 marks are 16 px --ink body text, not 14 px --ink2. Line numbers of the review checked: all current; the button height rule is site.css:664-668 and 1677-1680 (the review cited 1362, which is only the width and margin of .idea .btn). Review item 1 is confirmed as stated (S:845-881 vocabulary, E:969 chips).

Names given by the description for the two keys the requirement leaves to the design: demo_accuracy_note (the receipt sentence) and how_stage_1_note (the stage-1 note). The code design confirms or renames them (decisions/0125 item 6, F5).

No-match result, width 1000 px and narrower: the block stands under the fixed list «Чего Sai пока не делает» (601-625 px high at 390 and 320), because REQ-111 criterion 12 keeps .r-sum + .r-lines with nothing between. The block is still above the button. Default: accepted. Alternative (block between receipt and list) needs a change of that criterion.

The block's h3 follows the h1 on how.html (skips h2); the review keeps h3 so that one markup serves both pages. Default: h3. A new 479 px breakpoint (stack the mark above the title below 480 px) and the wrapper class r-side, and the classes stat, stat-line, pair, now are the new CSS names; no new token.

Outside the write set and left unedited: 7.12 still names the label «<accuracy>» and says no accuracy row on no match (the no-row rule stays true; the label is overridden by 7.22); section 17 item D20 still says «a fine line» for the result panel; the map of section 14 has no REQ-113 row; the sizes of the status block are estimates [C] (first screen top about y 560-600 at 390x844, r-side about 700 px at 1470, left column about 900 px or more): the run of REQ-113 measures them. REQ-113 criterion 11 requires that no text describes the removed line as part of the panel, so D20 (and the 14 row) need a later edit by a step that may touch them.
